author: /root/construct_integer_witnesses
claim: Actual normalized elliptic points with selective additive sign map; integer relation exclusion with explicit exact-point nontorsion inputs.

obligations.name: Actual coefficient and field
obligations.required_input: The normalizers must use the original coefficient and a genuine field.
obligations.constructed_input: Unchanged NormalizingRadicals318; delta^2=D and the literal Both field.
obligations.justification: The copied producer is hash-bound and no root-field assumption replaces its nonsquare proofs.

obligations.name: Normalization direction
obligations.required_input: r^2=base(d) must send v^2=1-d^2*u^4 to the coefficient-one curve.
obligations.constructed_input: normalized_curve proves u maps to r*base(u), v to base(v).
obligations.justification: Map the original equation and use (r*u)^4=(r^2)^2*u^4. Reciprocal coordinates therefore divide by r^2 and r^3.

obligations.name: Domain and exceptional cases
obligations.required_input: All specified coordinates and integer indices must be covered, including u=0.
obligations.constructed_input: firstPoint and secondPoint retain the zero-aware point constructor; v is explicitly nonzero.
obligations.justification: No inverse of u is formed outside the original zero-aware constructor; every integer m,n is quantified.

obligations.name: Actual target group
obligations.required_input: The target must be the actual elliptic group, not an assumed operation on coordinates.
obligations.justification: ShortCurveBaseChange318 and ReciprocalDouble318 use Mathlib nonsingular points and its actual addition.

obligations.name: Base-change and coefficient transport
obligations.required_input: The selective field involution must induce an actual additive map on the same curve.
obligations.constructed_input: flipPoint composes pointMap with transport along flipSecond(1)=1.
obligations.justification: The existing pointMap is an additive homomorphism; transport_point checks identity of the point after coefficient transport.

obligations.name: Selective group signs
obligations.required_input: The original fixed/negated roots must become the corresponding actual point signs.
obligations.constructed_input: flipPoint_first and flipPoint_second fix and negate the exact normalized points.
obligations.justification: Base coordinates are fixed, the radical signs are known, and point_negative establishes the group-negation identity including u=0.

obligations.name: Integer relation elimination
obligations.required_input: Nontorsion must apply to the very points occurring in the relation.
obligations.constructed_input: The consumer explicitly takes nontorsion of firstPoint and secondPoint.
obligations.justification: The additive involution gives (2n)*secondPoint=0; integer nontorsion forces n=0 and then m=0.

obligations.name: Original-to-real consumer boundary
obligations.required_input: No point-map or density comparison may be inferred from coordinate formulas alone.
obligations.constructed_input: Original nontorsion transport, real embeddings, circle/character comparison, and the concrete component-good intersection remain open.
obligations.justification: Only the target involution is proved additive here. No density or m=1 assertion follows from this packet.

obligations.name: History and validation scope
obligations.required_input: Prior justification and new formal progress must be distinguished.
obligations.constructed_input: Historical compact-Lie justification is retained; source policy passed, hosted Lean and distinct review pending.
obligations.justification: No accepted source or full arithmetic theorem is modified or claimed proved.
